topic: Letting a teenager's summer earnings sit in checking vs opening a custodial Roth (Simon vs Juniper)

scenes.narration: A teenager's summer job can quietly create a millionaire. Today's patient checkup starts here.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named doctor dollar, dark curly hair, round gold-rim glasses, kind smile, white doctor coat over teal scrubs, golden stethoscope shaped like a dollar sign, holding a clipboard with a credit-score chart, doctor dollar in a bright clinic holding a clipboard showing a tiny deposit growing into a huge chart, comic burst banner reads SUMMER JOB MILLIONAIRE, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Simon and Juniper each have a daughter working summers.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, split panel of man simon and woman juniper beside teenage daughters in work aprons, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Each daughter earns four thousand dollars every summer.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, two pay stubs reading FOUR THOUSAND SUMMER EARNINGS, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Simon lets the money sit in a checking account.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a checking account balance slowly draining across a summer, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: It is spent on clothes and gas within months.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, shopping bags and a fuel pump beside an empty account, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Juniper opens a custodial Roth in her daughter's name.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, woman juniper and her daughter opening an account labeled CUSTODIAL ROTH, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Earned income allows contributions, even for a teenager.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a rule card reading EARNED INCOME ALLOWS CONTRIBUTIONS, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: They invest three thousand each summer for four years.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, four summer deposits stacking up labeled THREE THOUSAND EACH, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Twelve thousand then grows untouched for fifty years.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a growth chart labeled TWELVE THOUSAND UNTOUCHED climbing steadily, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: At seven percent it becomes over three hundred thousand.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a chart peaking at THREE HUNDRED THOUSAND beside a grown daughter, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Every dollar comes out completely tax free.
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, a withdrawal slip stamped TAX FREE with a healthy heartbeat line, kids comic book illustration

scenes.narration: Open a custodial Roth their first working summer. See you next visit. Stay financially healthy!
scenes.image_prompt: kids graphic novel page panel, illustrated comic book art, bold flat colors clean black ink lines, cartoon woman named doctor dollar, dark curly hair, round gold-rim glasses, kind smile, white doctor coat over teal scrubs, golden stethoscope shaped like a dollar sign, holding a clipboard with a credit-score chart, doctor dollar in a bright clinic holding a clipboard reading CUSTODIAL ROTH FIRST SUMMER, a healthy growth chart behind her, kids comic book illustration
